expansions.description: Map of outline point index to expanded content

mechanism: A {{topology}} in which one root outline fans out into points that can be expanded concurrently: a single level of breadth with no edges between siblings. The shape is what buys latency — every point is independent, so expansion parallelises — and what costs depth, since no point can build on another's result. Names the structure only; the generate-then-expand procedure over it belongs to its consumers.
invariants: Independence: no point's expansion may depend on another point's expansion.
Single level: the outline is one level of breadth — a point that itself fans out is a {{topology}} of a different shape.
